item.title: DoHDA blames humans if algorithm gets SAH assessment wrong
item.description: The department wants it both ways, forbidding clinical assessors from correcting the IAT’s mistakes and then saying it’s the assessors’ fault if the IAT makes the mistake in the first place. item.title: Our healthcare system in the evolving ‘SaaSpocalypse’ paradigm
item.description: AI is suddenly challenging the premise that software as a service healthcare platforms are highly defensible (and therefore valuable) long-term business models. There are big implications for the medical software sector, provider productivity and, ultimately, patient outcomes. The post Our healthcare system in the evolving ‘SaaSpocalypse’ paradigm appeared first on Medical Republic.
